title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A classic Roman pasta dish made with eggs, hard cheese, cured pork, and black pepper. Creamy, rich, and utterly satisfying.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Meanwhile, cook guanciale in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy. Add garlic and cook 1 minute, then remove garlic.
Whisk together eggs, Pecorino Romano, and Parmesan in a bowl. Season generously with black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Drain pasta and immediately add to the skillet off the heat.
Pour egg mixture over pasta, tossing quickly and adding pasta water gradually to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper.
author: Chef Marco
